fusions.name: Hawser Lash
fusions.desc: Lashes a rope of braided strands at a target up to 6 tiles away, dealing 16 blunt damage that rises to 2 times that at full reach, and knocks it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Cinching Snap
fusions.desc: Every strand snaps tight around you at once, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and ignoring their armour.

fusions.name: Braided Sinew
fusions.desc: Plaits your strands into cables across your back, raising your armour by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Dead Weight
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, you deal 40% more physical damage for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
